Initial release: Animate still images into video clips using AI with simple, text-based controls.

- Upload product or landscape photos and generate 1080p MP4 video clips in 30–60 seconds.
- Hassle-free interface: no manual timeline editing or export settings required.
- Automatic cloud backend setup; handles user authentication and session management transparently.
- Supports direct user prompts for export, balance, status, and upload actions.
- Robust error handling with clear feedback for common issues and quota limits.
- Multiple video, image, and audio formats supported for exports.
